description: Election Commission - Declare that Walgama Ariyafiththi Thero Elected as the member of the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the nomination and declaration of an elected member to fill a seat vacated by death. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of election results for public offices.
